```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Map categorical variables to numeric for plotting
le = LabelEncoder()
data['sex'] = le.fit_transform(data['sex'])
data['class'] = le.fit_transform(data['class'])
data['embarked'] = le.fit_transform(data['embarked'])
data['alive'] = le.fit_transform(data['alive'])

# Create a violin plot to compare age distribution of survived and not survived passengers
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.violinplot(x='survived', y='age', data=data)
plt.title('Age Distribution of Survived and Not Survived Passengers')
plt.xlabel('Survived')
plt.ylabel('Age')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
